title: Plans for Allied Educators in Schools for Learning and Classroom Support
what_it_is: Plans for Allied Educators in Schools for Learning and Classroom Support

sections.label: Growth of school support staff
sections.summary: Over five years, School Counsellors, Student Welfare Officers and AEDs(LBS) grew over 30%, with about 100 AEDs(T&L) sponsored for DISE and another 100 planned this year.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Over the last five years, we have grown the number of School Counsellors, Student Welfare Officers and AEDs(LBS) by over 30%, and we intend to expand this further to meet the growing needs of our students.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: For example, over the last two years, we have sponsored around 100 AEDs(T&L) to a 10-month full-time Diploma in Special Education (DISE) at the National Institute of Education (NIE) and plan to train another 100 this year.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: MOE will continue to review our AED numbers and workforce profile to ensure that we respond effectively to students’ needs.

sections.label: Growth in three AED types
sections.summary: The number of these three types of AEDs has grown by more than 30% and recruitment continues.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: The number has grown for these three types of AEDs.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: It has grown by more than 30% and we are still recruiting.

sections.label: Improved teacher-to-student ratio
sections.summary: Smaller student enrolment and a healthy teaching force have improved the teacher-to-student ratio, so teachers rely slightly less on AEDs(T&L) for generic classroom support.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: For example, with smaller student enrolment and with a healthy teaching force, in general, our teacher-to-student ratio has come down, has improved, which also means that now, the teachers rely slightly less on the AEDs(T&L) to provide generic classroom support than many, many years ago.

sections.label: Reshaping teaching workforce and recruitment
sections.summary: The teaching workforce will be reshaped, recruitment of School Counsellors, Student Welfare Officers and AEDs(LBS) ramped up, and AEDs(T&L) supported with sponsorship or NIE courses to switch roles.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: Earlier on, I did mention that from time to time, we will look at reshaping our teaching workforce, including the AEDs.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: And moving forward, we are looking at ramping up the recruitment of School Counsellors, Student Welfare Officers and AEDs(LBS).

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: For existing AEDs(T&L) who are keen to make the transition or career switch to any of these three roles or even other roles in the teaching force, we will support the AEDs(T&L) in doing so with the necessary sponsorship or diploma courses in NIE or even very specialised courses to support them, so that they can continue to support students, whether it is students with special educational needs or students who need counselling and so on.
